ValidationRule.description: VR-QLI-04: On CO lines tied to an existing Asset (Change_Type__c CHANGE/CHANGE_PRICE/DELETE), blocks editing Quantity or Product_Attribute_Value__c post-creation, to keep the CO line 1:1 with its Odoo IB. NEW lines are unaffected.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISNEW()), NOT(ISBLANK(Asset__c)), OR( ISPICKVAL(Change_Type__c, 'CHANGE'), ISPICKVAL(Change_Type__c, 'CHANGE_PRICE'), ISPICKVAL(Change_Type__c, 'DELETE') ), OR( ISCHANGED(Quantity), ISCHANGED(Product_Attribute_Value__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Quantity and Attribute can't be edited here — this line came from a Change Order and is tied to an existing Odoo service. Changing it directly would desync the order from that service. Create a new Change Order to adjust quantity or attribute instead.
